lines.zh: 我走的时候，第二趾是翘起来的
lines.en: I walk with my second toe held up

lines.zh: 森林和针叶林里，我踩得很轻
lines.en: In forest and taiga I step lightly

lines.zh: 身子前倾，尾巴在后面伸直
lines.en: Body forward, tail straight behind
I go step by step, as if measuring

lines.zh: 我们两三只一起，散开走
lines.en: Two or three of us, spread as we go

lines.zh: 落叶和松针在我脚下不出声
lines.en: Leaves and needles make no sound under me

lines.zh: 我的爪子收着，走路不刮地
lines.en: My claws are held up, they do not scrape
I walk a stretch and stop to listen

lines.zh: 树影一片一片在我背上过
lines.en: Tree shadows pass over my back in patches
I walk close to the brush, inconspicuous

lines.zh: 我跑起来，尾巴帮我转弯
lines.en: When I run, my tail helps me turn

lines.zh: 我从这块岩跳到那块岩
lines.en: I spring from one rock to the next
I follow the tail of the one ahead

lines.zh: 我伏在低枝上，一动不动
lines.en: I crouch on a low branch, motionless
Head down, my eyes never stop

lines.zh: 我一只脚抬着，随时能跳
lines.en: One foot raised, ready to spring

lines.zh: 林子里的声音我都记着
lines.en: I keep track of every sound here
My feathers lie flat
My kin are far off, each holding a side
I turn my neck slowly
My shadow falls on the pine needles
Nothing is moving, and I do not relax
I hook my toes into the branch
I flick my tail and stop
We have held this stretch a long while
I hook my claws into the bark

lines.zh: 我一动，松针就落下去几根
lines.en: When I move, a few needles fall

lines.zh: 你走进来的时候，我已经在树上了
lines.en: By the time you walked in, I was in the tree
I look down at you, very close

lines.zh: 你背后那一侧，有我的同伴
lines.en: My kin are on the side behind you
I have been looking at your neck a long while
I tilt my head, my feathers lift once

lines.zh: 你不该一个人进这片林子
lines.en: You should not enter this forest alone
You stand below me
I lift a foot and set it back on the branch

lines.zh: 你听见上面的声音了吗
lines.en: Did you hear the sound above

lines.zh: 我这张脸很小，可牙不少
lines.en: My face is small, my teeth are not few
I am higher up than you think

lines.zh: 镰刀爪打滑，我单脚撑住。
lines.en: My sickle claw slips and I brace on one leg.
My feathers are torn
I retreat behind a root

lines.zh: 这一下不轻，可我还站得住
lines.en: That was hard, and I can still stand
The wound is on my leg, running hurts
My tail sweeps the ground

lines.zh: 同伴看了一眼，没有过来
lines.en: My kin glance over and do not come
I flatten and pant
You landed that one on me
You hold meat in the middle of the forest
I lean down from the branch
That will not be shared among us
Put it down and step back three paces
I am in no hurry to come down
My kin are eyeing it too
Holding it up like that will tire you
I move first, then the others dare
This smells too familiar
We will talk after it is eaten
One touch and I drop under the branch

lines.zh: 你的重量和我不成比例
lines.en: Your weight is out of proportion with mine
I pulled back, and not far

lines.zh: 这一下，我记住你的位置
lines.en: That gave me your position
Do not walk close beneath the trees
I have slipped behind the tree
Pine needles fell all over me
I took one on the leg
Touch again and I come down from above
We are always several together
First, let us see who strikes true
The feathers must rise nicely, that is the standard
There is not enough of this forest to share out
You are standing the wrong way
That comes after eating
No answer, so let it pass
We each have our own branch
Move along, you are in my way
I jump down and land beside it
I hold it under a toe
It is hard under my claw
Not meat, something hard

lines.zh: 我用嘴叼起来，跳回树上
lines.en: I take it in my mouth and leap back up
My kin watch from the branch
It is not very heavy
I put it in the fork of the tree
Whoever gets it first keeps it
I see it, now
I stand up on the branch
We are on your four sides

lines.zh: 你踏进这片林子，我们就知道了
lines.en: We knew the moment you entered this forest

lines.zh: 我压低身子，脚趾扣住枝
lines.en: I flatten and hook my toes on the branch
You move first, then we do

lines.zh: 这棵树上的位置，都归我们
lines.en: The places in these trees are ours
I gave one short call
My kin are coming down on both sides
Your paths are already closed
I have opened my claws
You look up and cannot find me

lines.zh: 我抬起头，脖子伸得很直
lines.en: I raise my head, neck straight
At this distance, two leaps exactly
Several of us, trading positions
The forest is too dark to count us

lines.zh: 我落下的时候你才知道
lines.en: You only learn when I land
Run for open ground, that is worse
The needles are moving, and it is not wind
One of us follows behind
Your turn is half a beat slow
We do not need to run
At this distance, two leaps suffice

lines.zh: 你再往前，就是我们的地
lines.en: Further on is our ground
I hear your breathing change
There is blood on your shoulder
I am pressed as low as I go
There is still a little light in the shade
I leap down, claws first

lines.zh: 脚趾上那根弯爪，扎得深
lines.en: The sickle claw on my toe goes deep
I land on your back

lines.zh: 这一下，你的肩膀开了口
lines.en: That opened your shoulder
I do not stop, I spring away
My kin strike from two directions at once
That came from above

lines.zh: 我咬在你脖子上，没咬实
lines.en: I bit at your neck, not deep

lines.zh: 你退了，树枝替你挡了一下
lines.en: You retreated and a branch took part of it
I land by the root and look back
That split your armor
Blood is dripping from my arm too
The second is already behind you
We do not commit all at once
A shape has appeared on a pine branch
I drop down, lightly
Two or three more in the forest
After landing, my claws stay sheathed
Something moves in the tree shade
We step on pine needles, silent
I lift a foot, the second toe raised
This forest is dark, just right
I look up, my kin are all in the branches
I shake the pine needles off
Birds start up in the distance

lines.zh: 我落地的位置，正好背风
lines.en: Where I landed faces away from the wind

lines.zh: 枝头晃了一下，我站好了
lines.en: The branch swayed and I settled
Every sound in the forest stopped
We called to one another
I landed between two forks
Fire curled my feathers

lines.zh: 我从高枝上摔下来，摔在林地上
lines.en: I fell from a high branch onto the forest floor

lines.zh: 泥水灌进羽毛，我浮不起来
lines.en: Muddy water soaks my feathers, I cannot float
The blast threw me against a trunk

lines.zh: 一支箭钉在我的翅膀上
lines.en: An arrow is stuck in my wing

lines.zh: 那股劲儿让我爪子发麻
lines.en: That force numbed my claws
There is no more game in this forest

lines.zh: 雷打在树上，我整只都僵了
lines.en: Lightning hit the tree and I went stiff
There are no branches here to stand on
